info.title: Bidora pilot Google authentication
info.description: Approved Google Authorization Code with PKCE browser contract. Handlers are implemented but routes are not registered or deployed.

post.summary: Create a single-use Google authorization transaction
post.description: Requires an exact approved HTTPS Origin, no body and no query. Commits short-lived state before returning a 303 to Google's fixed authorization endpoint and sets a host-only correlation cookie.

303.description: Transaction committed. Redirect to Google with state, nonce and S256 PKCE challenge.

get.description: Accepts exactly one state and code, requires the host-only correlation cookie, consumes state before exchange, and always clears the correlation cookie. Success atomically commits a Bidora session/audit, sets session and CSRF cookies and redirects to the fixed success destination. Every expected callback/authentication failure redirects to one fixed failure destination without diagnostics.

303.description: Fixed configured success or generic failure redirect. Correlation cookie is cleared; session cookies are present only after successful commit.

Failure.description: Generic safe pre-redirect failure. Provider, code, state, cookie and dependency diagnostics are never returned.

x-cookie-policy.correlation: __Host-bidora_google_oidc; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; no Domain; explicit transaction TTL
x-cookie-policy.session: __Host-bidora_session; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; no Domain
